gaps: P0–P1: no candidates; P2: only a low-resolution Merian plate (#1) with a fold through a faint distant skyline, skipped; P5: only a 1915-postmarked postcard dominated by the station yard (#12, picture date unknown) and a 1965 flood aerial
notes: #4’s 1786–1826 is the Rijksmuseum’s estimate (y is the midpoint); #5 is another state of the same plate. #2/#3 are Guardi’s Prato della Valle (Padua) in the Dijon museum; #10/#11 are Lyon (Place Bellecour, Croix-Rousse). Photochrom #6 is marked ‘P.Z.’ (Photoglob Zürich). P6 pick is a single building; replace if a skyline or Palais des Ducs photo turns up.
